title: Blocking host-to-device copies and per-step synchronization in a training data pipeline
authoring_note: Baseline uses the declared DataLoader worker/prefetch/pinned-memory workload but blocking .to()+synchronize per step. Oracle preserves that loader workload and enables non_blocking copies without per-step synchronization. Calibrated on a CUDA host: the speedup is modest but real for this memory-bound pipeline.
author: batch-C prototype agent
